hero.prompt: A vast atmospheric landscape at the precise moment the storm breaks open — dark churning indigo clouds split across a wide sky releasing amber-gold light through curtains of falling rain, the wet earth below gleaming teal where storm shadow meets the incoming dawn, a solitary tear-shaped cloud at the zenith still pouring its last silver rain while golden radiance floods the entire horizon, the air luminous with fresh moisture and the feeling of pressure dissolved into clarity — deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), teal-and-gold nebula wash, painterly editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame, ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: Storm clouds parting to reveal a golden-teal horizon at the moment of renewal, symbolizing Ardra nakshatra
hero.altZh: 风暴乌云散开，金色与蓝绿光芒照亮大地，象征阿德拉星宿的风暴到更新

linesEn: Intensity is a problem to fix
linesZh: 罗睺主管就意味着倒霉
强度是个要修掉的毛病

linesEn: Teardrop is Rudra's cleansing rain — the washing-clean phase of a renewal cycle
Rahu amplifies and intensifies; overwhelm and insight share the same amplifying source
Rudra dissolves the stagnant so renewal can follow — functional, not purposeless destruction
Intensity is the gateway; the cycle reaches clarity through pressure, not around it
linesZh: 泪滴是楼陀罗风暴里带来清洗的雨，是更新周期里的冲刷阶段
罗睺放大、强化，超载与洞见都来自同一个放大源
楼陀罗消解停滞以让更新随后到来——是有功能的破坏，而非为乱而乱
强度是入口；循环穿过压力抵达清晰，消灭强度也就消灭了它本会带来的突破
